en: The image depicts a vintage exhibition booth with the number 65, displaying a variety of metal products, documents, and boxes. The booth is decorated with a large black banner featuring the word 'ЛОРМЪ' (LORM) and the years '1922-1932', with a winged wheel design made of metallic parts. Above the booth, there is a sign in Bulgarian Cyrillic advertising an industrial company from Varna, Bulgaria, specializing in metal products. The booth appears to be part of a trade fair or industrial exhibition.
